title: Deploy payment-service hotfix (auth retry logic)
description:
Deploy commit a3f7c2d to production which adds retry logic with exponential backoff for authentication token refresh calls in payment-service. This addresses the cascading failure mode identified in the June 12 P1 incident (INC-2024-0612-001).

The fix adds:
- Circuit breaker pattern for token validation calls
- Exponential backoff (100ms, 200ms, 400ms, max 3 retries)
- Fallback to cached token when refresh fails
- Memory pressure monitoring hook

Requires VP Engineering sign-off per change management policy Section 4.2 due to payment-service criticality classification.
scope: Deploy commit a3f7c2d to production with standard canary process
note: Awaiting VP Engineering sign-off per change management policy Section 4.2
